shots.scene: 欣欣站在一台化学通风柜旁，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a chemical fume hood with its glass sash at working height and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲通风柜的良好操作习惯。
overlay: 通风柜的良好操作习惯

shots.scene: 四个图标：检测标签、报警灯、前窗、扫帚
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row: a blank inspection label, an alarm lamp, a sliding sash, and a cleaning cloth. No people.
shots.narration: 看标签、听报警、调前窗、勤清理。

shots.scene: 阿杰坐在通风柜前，脸低于前窗下沿，柜里堆满了瓶子
shots.prompt_en: The young male student sits on a stool at a fume hood with his face below the sash edge; the hood is crowded with many bottles.
shots.narration: 阿杰坐着干活，柜里堆满了瓶子。

shots.scene: 报警面板灯在闪，声音被关成静音，阿杰没察觉
shots.prompt_en: An alarm lamp blinks on the hood's blank monitor panel with a muted speaker icon; the young male student does not notice.
shots.narration: 报警灯在闪，可声音被关掉了。

shots.scene: 小研走过来指着报警灯
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student walks over and points at the blinking alarm lamp.
shots.narration: 小研赶紧提醒：先停下！

shots.section_title: 好习惯保证通风柜性能
shots.scene: 欣欣在通风柜前竖起大拇指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot gives a thumbs-up in front of a tidy fume hood.
shots.narration: 通风柜好不好用，一半看使用习惯。
overlay: 好习惯保证通风柜性能

shots.scene: 前窗旁一张空白检测标签，上面有日历和风速表图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank inspection label beside the sash with a calendar icon and a small airflow gauge icon. No people.
shots.narration: 通风柜定期检测，柜前贴着检测标签。

shots.scene: 小研用手指着标签核对日期
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student points at the blank inspection label and checks the calendar icon.
shots.narration: 用前看一眼：检测过没有，过没过期。

shots.scene: 过期标签的图标被红叉划掉，旁边电话图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of an expired inspection label crossed out with a red X, next to a telephone icon. No people.
shots.narration: 过期或没检测，先报告，别使用。

shots.scene: 通风柜侧面的风量监测面板，绿灯亮
shots.prompt_en: An airflow monitor panel on the side of the fume hood with a green light on and a blank display. No people.
shots.narration: 每台通风柜，都该有风量报警器。

shots.scene: 面板绿灯变红灯，出现低风量图标
shots.prompt_en: The monitor panel light changes from green to red with a low airflow arrow icon. No people.
shots.narration: 风量不够时，它就会报警。

shots.scene: 小研停下手里的操作，盖好瓶盖
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student stops her work and caps the open bottles inside the hood.
shots.narration: 一旦报警，马上停止工作。

shots.scene: 小研慢慢拉下前窗
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student slowly pulls the sash all the way down.
shots.narration: 把前窗拉下来。

shots.scene: 小研打电话报告老周和王老师
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student phones the older man; the safety administrator is shown answering at her desk.
shots.narration: 报告负责人和学院安全管理人员。

shots.scene: 报警面板上的灯光图标和喇叭图标
shots.prompt_en: An alarm panel with a flashing lamp icon and a speaker icon side by side. No people.
shots.narration: 报警器常有灯光和声音两种提示。

shots.scene: 喇叭被调成静音的图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a speaker switched to mute, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 声音别关掉，

shots.scene: 阿杰埋头操作时被响声惊醒，抬头看报警灯
shots.prompt_en: The young male student, focused on his work, looks up when the alarm sounds.
shots.narration: 低头干活时，一响就能发现。

shots.scene: 手指按住面板上的复位键，旁边一本空白说明书
shots.prompt_en: A gloved finger holds a reset button on the monitor panel, next to a blank instrument manual. No people.
shots.narration: 处理好后，按说明书复位报警器。

shots.scene: 老李对照说明书测试报警器，红灯亮起
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer tests the fume hood alarm following a blank manual; the red alarm light comes on.
shots.narration: 报警器灵不灵，可以按说明书测试。

shots.scene: 老李在空白记录本上打勾
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer ticks a box in a blank maintenance logbook.
shots.narration: 测试结果，记录在案。

shots.scene: 小研双手滑动玻璃前窗
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student slides the glass sash with both hands.
shots.narration: 前窗可以上下滑动，

shots.scene: 前窗下沿对齐柜上的标定线，打绿勾
shots.prompt_en: The bottom edge of the sash lines up with a marked line on the hood frame, with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 干活时，下沿对准柜上的标定线。

shots.scene: 前窗推到很高，柜里的蒸气从下沿飘出
shots.prompt_en: The sash is pushed up very high, and vapor drifts out under its bottom edge into the room. No people.
shots.narration: 前窗开得太高，进风变慢，

shots.scene: 飘出的蒸气飘向操作者，警示三角
shots.prompt_en: Vapor wisps drift from the hood opening toward a person's face icon, with a yellow warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 蒸气就可能漏出来。

shots.section_title: 前窗挡在脸和化学品之间
shots.scene: 侧面示意：脸在前窗玻璃外侧，化学品在里面
shots.prompt_en: Side view diagram: the glass sash sits between a standing person's face and the chemical bottles inside the hood. No people.
shots.narration: 前窗要挡在脸和化学品之间。
overlay: 前窗挡在脸和化学品之间

shots.section_title: 前窗挡在脸和化学品之间
shots.scene: 前窗下沿正对口鼻的示意被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A side view diagram with the sash bottom edge level with the person's nose and mouth, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 下沿对着口鼻，就挡不住了。

shots.scene: 小研站在通风柜前操作，前窗挡住脸
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student stands at the fume hood and works with the sash in front of her face.
shots.narration: 一般要站着操作。

shots.scene: 坐在矮凳上、脸低于前窗下沿的示意被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A side view diagram of a person sitting on a low stool with the face below the sash edge, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 坐得太低，脸就到了前窗下面。

shots.scene: 把头探进通风柜的图标被大红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a person leaning their head inside a fume hood, crossed out with a large red X. No people.
shots.narration: 绝不要把头伸进通风柜。

shots.scene: 小研站在柜外，隔着前窗玻璃观察
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student looks through the glass sash from outside the hood while working.
shots.narration: 要看清楚，就隔着玻璃看。

shots.scene: 前窗拉得很低，柜内气流打旋
shots.prompt_en: The sash is lowered almost to the work surface; airflow arrows inside the hood swirl and loop. No people.
shots.narration: 前窗也不是越低越好。

shots.scene: 旋涡把烟带出柜口的示意
shots.prompt_en: Swirling airflow carries a puff of vapor back out at the front edge. No people.
shots.narration: 太低风速变大，湍流也可能带出蒸气。

shots.scene: 柜内只放着一瓶试剂、一个烧杯和一个试管架
shots.prompt_en: Inside the fume hood there is only one reagent bottle, one beaker and one tube rack. No people.
shots.narration: 柜内只放这次实验要用的东西。

shots.scene: 柜内堆满溶剂瓶的图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a fume hood crowded with many solvent bottles, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 别把通风柜当成试剂储存柜。

shots.scene: 小研把多余的试剂放回专用储存柜
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student returns extra solvent bottles to a ventilated flammable storage cabinet.
shots.narration: 用不上的，放回专用储存柜。

shots.scene: 柜后部排风缝前空出一段距离，气流箭头均匀
shots.prompt_en: Inside the hood, the rear exhaust slots are clear and even airflow arrows pass across the work surface. No people.
shots.narration: 后部排风口前，不要放东西。

shots.scene: 大瓶子挡住排风缝的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a large bottle blocking the rear exhaust slots, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 气流要均匀地流过整个台面。

shots.scene: 物品紧挨柜口前沿，烟从下沿翻出
shots.prompt_en: A tip box sits right at the front edge of the hood; smoke rolls out over the sill. No people.
shots.narration: 柜口也一样，东西别贴着前沿放。

shots.scene: 小研把物品往里挪
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student slides the box farther back into the hood.
shots.narration: 往里挪一挪，气流才顺。

shots.scene: 小研把用完的物品移出柜外
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student removes items she no longer needs from the hood.
shots.narration: 做完实验，把用不上的东西拿出来。

shots.scene: 小研用湿纸巾擦拭柜内台面
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student wipes the hood work surface with a damp paper towel.
shots.narration: 擦干净台面，

shots.scene: 干净整洁的通风柜，前窗关到位
shots.prompt_en: A clean, empty fume hood with the sash lowered. No people.
shots.narration: 下一位来用，干干净净。

shots.section_title: 本课不替代本实验室规程
shots.scene: 欣欣举着空白的通风柜使用规程
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a blank fume hood procedure binder.
shots.narration: 这一课是基础，具体以本实验室规程为准。
overlay: 本课不替代本实验室规程

shots.section_title: 柜内溢洒和着火怎么办
shots.scene: 柜内一小滩溶剂洒在台面上
shots.prompt_en: A small solvent spill on the work surface inside the fume hood. No people.
shots.narration: 柜内洒了少量溶剂，前窗拉低，
overlay: 柜内溢洒和着火怎么办

shots.section_title: 柜内溢洒和着火怎么办
shots.scene: 小研戴手套用吸附棉吸干，放进专用袋
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student, in goggles and gloves, soaks up the spill with absorbent pads and puts them into a labeled waste bag.
shots.narration: 用吸附材料吸干，按危险废物收集。

shots.section_title: 柜内溢洒和着火怎么办
shots.scene: 柜内小火苗，小研关闭加热电源、拉下前窗
shots.prompt_en: A small flame appears inside the hood; the female graduate student switches off the heater power and lowers the sash.
shots.narration: 着了小火：断开热源，拉下前窗。

shots.section_title: 柜内溢洒和着火怎么办
shots.scene: 小研拿起灭火器，旁边是119电话图标
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student picks up a fire extinguisher; a telephone icon with the number 119 appears beside her.
shots.narration: 会用就用灭火器，控制不住拨119。

shots.section_title: 柜内溢洒和着火怎么办
shots.scene: 大家沿安全出口标志撤离，小研报告老周
shots.prompt_en: Lab members evacuate following an emergency exit sign; the female graduate student phones the older man.
shots.narration: 人员撤离，并报告负责人。

shots.section_title: 废液不能在柜里挥发掉
shots.scene: 敞口的废液烧杯放在柜里挥发的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of an open waste solvent beaker left in a fume hood to evaporate, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 废液不能放在柜里让它挥发掉。
overlay: 废液不能在柜里挥发掉

shots.section_title: 废液不能在柜里挥发掉
shots.scene: 小研把废液倒进贴着空白标签的专用废液桶，盖紧
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student pours waste solvent through a funnel into a dedicated waste container with a blank label, then caps it tightly.
shots.narration: 倒进专用废液桶，随手盖紧。

shots.section_title: 废液不能在柜里挥发掉
shots.scene: 废液桶分类排列，学校收运车停在楼外
shots.prompt_en: Labeled waste containers sorted in a tray; a campus hazardous waste collection cart waits outside the building. No people.
shots.narration: 分类登记，交学校统一处置。

shots.section_title: 易燃溶剂远离电器和热源
shots.scene: 柜内的溶剂瓶远离加热板，插座装在柜外
shots.prompt_en: Inside the hood, solvent bottles are kept away from a hot plate; the electrical outlets are mounted outside the hood. No people.
shots.narration: 柜里有易燃溶剂，热源要远离。
overlay: 易燃溶剂远离电器和热源

shots.section_title: 易燃溶剂远离电器和热源
shots.scene: 柜内点燃的酒精灯图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a lit burner flame inside a fume hood next to solvent bottles, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不用明火，电器插头别放在柜里插拔。

shots.section_title: 易燃溶剂远离电器和热源
shots.scene: 溶剂瓶用完立即盖紧
shots.prompt_en: A gloved hand caps a solvent bottle right after use. No people.
shots.narration: 溶剂用完马上盖好。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在通风柜旁，身边浮现五个图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a tidy fume hood with five icons floating beside it.
shots.narration: 记住这几条：

shots.scene: 阿杰站起来，前窗拉到标定线，柜里只留需要的东西
shots.prompt_en: The young male student stands at the hood with the sash at the marked line and only the needed items inside.
shots.narration: 阿杰站好、调好前窗，柜里清清爽爽。

shots.scene: 报警声恢复，绿灯亮
shots.prompt_en: The alarm panel shows a green light with the speaker icon switched back on. No people.
shots.narration: 报警器开着声音，安心干活。

shots.scene: 欣欣挥手告别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye beside the fume hood.
shots.narration: 好习惯，让通风柜真正护住你。
